new_libraries.name: EmbeddedTemporal
new_libraries.author: Roy Darnell
new_libraries.sentence: Run a Mistral Workflows / Temporal activity worker on an ESP32.
new_libraries.paragraph: The ESP32 registers as a worker, long-polls for activity tasks over gRPC/TLS (HTTP/2 via bundled nghttp2, protobuf via bundled nanopb), runs your handler, and reports the result. No cloud SDK, no host in the loop. Requires the ESP32 Arduino core 3.x (Arduino IDE: esp32 boards package 3.0.0 or newer).

library.name: Alteriom PainlessMesh
library.author: Coopdis,Scotty Franzyshen,Edwin van Leeuwen,Germán Martín,Maximilian Schwarz,Doanh Doanh,Alteriom
library.sentence: A painless way to setup a mesh with ESP8266 and ESP32 devices with Alteriom extensions
library.paragraph: painlessMesh is a user-friendly library for creating mesh networks with ESP8266 and ESP32 devices. This Alteriom fork includes additional packages for sensor data (SensorPackage), device commands (CommandPackage), and status monitoring (StatusPackage). It handles routing and network management automatically, so you can focus on your application. The library uses JSON-based messaging and syncs time across all nodes, making it ideal for coordinated behaviour like synchronized light displays or sensor networks reporting to a central node.

library.name: TheengsDecoder
library.author: Florian Robert, Ryan Powell
library.sentence: A simple, efficient, portable and lightweight library for Internet of Things messages decoding.
library.paragraph: Theengs Decoder library translates sensors data chains into human readable data leveraging the well known data interchange format JSON. This format can easily be integrated into different systems or software.
